highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Security validation should begin where attackers begin and Why security validation must follow the attack path. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Shai-Hulud strikes again: CHAINDROP worm hits 400+ npm packages. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Ransom Cartel ransomware creator sentenced to 16 years in prison. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
